subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should configured channel load/register failures use when the plugin never reaches `listChannelPlugins()`?
rationale: A repair needs maintainer intent because fail-fast startup, warn-and-continue channel audits, hot reload, and process-stable plugin metadata have different upgrade and operator-impact tradeoffs.

options.title: Add Warn-And-Continue Audit
options.body: Keep Gateway startup compatible, but emit a clear configured-channel audit that lists configured channels missing after plugin activation with registry diagnostic reasons.

options.title: Fail Fast For Configured Channels
options.body: Treat configured channel load/register failures as startup blockers, improving visibility but risking upgrades where users relied on partial channel startup.

options.title: Wait For Live Feishu Proof
options.body: Keep current diagnostics until maintainers capture a live Windows Feishu mismatch and decide the exact failure severity from real logs.

recommendation.title: Add Warn-And-Continue Audit
recommendation.body: Keep Gateway startup compatible, but emit a clear configured-channel audit that lists configured channels missing after plugin activation with registry diagnostic reasons.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Gateway startup behavior and channel/plugin diagnostics where the current checkout and related history point to this owner as the broadest routing candidate.
